user.title: Connect to EmotionKit
user.description: The integration connects to https://emotionkit.de. Choose a name for this Home Assistant; you will get a claim code in the next step.

data_description.device_name: Shown in Home Assistant. The name you enter on the EmotionKit website when claiming the device replaces it.

claim_failed.title: Registration not completed
claim_failed.description: Submit to get a new claim code and try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Claim the device again
reauth_confirm.description:
The EmotionKit server no longer accepts the credentials of this device. It was probably deleted in the EmotionKit web interface.

Submit to get a new claim code. Your automations and entities are kept.

reconfigure.title: MQTT broker
reconfigure.description: Change the address of the EmotionKit MQTT broker. Leave the field empty to use the address announced by the EmotionKit server.

data_description.mqtt_broker: For example tcp://host:1883, tls://host:8883 or wss://host/mqtt.

progress.wait_for_claim:
Open {url}, add a device and enter this code:

**{claim_code}**

This dialog continues on its own as soon as the code has been entered. A code is valid for 15 minutes; after that a new one is shown here.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the EmotionKit server.
error.timeout_connect: The EmotionKit server did not answer in time. Please try again.
error.server_busy: The EmotionKit server is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
error.invalid_response: The EmotionKit server sent an unexpected answer.
error.claim_timeout: The code was not entered in time.
error.invalid_broker: Enter a valid broker URL, for example tcp://host:1883, tls://host:8883 or wss://host/mqtt.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.reauth_successful: The device was claimed again and is connected with its new credentials.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The MQTT broker address was saved.

data_description.idle_timeout: The idle trigger fires when no game data has arrived for this long. 0 turns it off.
data_description.react_to_all_players: Player triggers such as kill, death or flashed normally fire for the owner of the device only. Turn this on to react to every player who shares the device.
